goal: Allow generateblock to create multiple coinbase outputs with custom or split rewards
Let generateblock mine from the mempool automatically by making the transaction list optional
Help testers simulate mining pool payout schemes like Ocean or Braidpool on regtest
agreement: Substantive support with all prior objections addressed
Supports simulating protocols that pay multiple recipients directly from coinbase (supertestnet)
Moved test-only mining changes out of node consensus logic to address maintainer feedback (maflcko)
Preserved backwards compatibility and added custom split amounts per feedback (achow101, stickies-v)
Avoided adding a redundant RPC by extending generateblock instead (andrewtoth)

categories.name: mining
why: P3 because it improves developer tooling to simulate mining pool payouts on regtest
It is deferrable test tooling that does not alter production block template assembly

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it answers downstream requests for more flexible block generation options in tests
The change is a deferrable testing enhancement to an existing RPC
